label: NORM
definition: Normal ECG with no other labelled abnormality

label: AVB
aha_statement: First-, second- (Mobitz I/II) and third-degree AV block
definition: Any degree of AV block; first degree = PR interval > 200 ms (stated as first-degree AV block or prolonged PR interval)

label: LVH
definition: Left ventricular hypertrophy by voltage and/or non-voltage criteria

label: STT_ISCH
aha_statement: ST deviation; T-wave abnormality (primary); suggestive of ischaemia/injury
definition: Primary ST-segment or T-wave abnormality, non-specific or suggestive of ischaemia/injury; secondary changes (hypertrophy, bundle branch block, conduction delay, pacing), early repolarisation and normal variants excluded
scp_ecg_codes: INJAL INJAS INJIL INJIN INJLA ISCAL ISCAN ISCAS ISCIL ISCIN ISCLA ISC_ NDT NST_ STD_

label: MI
definition: ECG pattern of myocardial infarction (acute or prior, e.g. pathological Q waves), as stated by the reader
scp_ecg_codes: ALMI AMI ASMI ILMI IMI IPLMI IPMI LMI PMI

label: RBBB
aha_statement: Complete or incomplete right bundle branch block
definition: Complete (QRS >= 120 ms) or incomplete (110-119 ms) RBBB (merged)

label: LBBB
aha_statement: Complete or incomplete left bundle branch block
definition: Complete (QRS >= 120 ms) or incomplete (110-119 ms) LBBB (merged)

label: FASC
aha_statement: Left anterior or left posterior fascicular block
definition: Left anterior or left posterior fascicular block (merged)

label: STACH
definition: Sinus tachycardia, as stated by the reader

label: SBRAD
definition: Sinus bradycardia, as stated by the reader
